[https://cole.house.gov/issues/life]
Life | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Life As penned in the Declaration of Independence, our forefathers founded America with the strong belief that individuals are "endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable rights." Among those is the right to life, which influences my commitment to protecting the most vulnerable, including the unborn. Since entering Congress, protection of life has been one of my highest priorities. Throughout my service in the U.S. House of Representatives, I have voted in support of life and currently have a 100 percent pro-life voting record. In the days ahead, I will continue to defend the sanctity of life with every vote I cast. I am also a staunch supporter of the Hyde Amendment that has protected life and prevented federal taxpayer-funded abortions for nearly 50 years. Since the Hyde Amendment was enacted in 1976, it is estimated that this provision on annual appropriations bills has saved more than two million lives while also protecting the conscience rights of the great majority of Americans who oppose public funding for abortions – either for religious, moral or fiscal reasons. Although the Hyde Amendment has historically been supported by lawmakers on both sides of the aisle and signed into law by presidents of both parties, Democrats have unfortunately shifted their position and sought to repeal Hyde. The result of doing so would impose a pro-abortion-funding policy on states that have decided against it. I vehemently oppose any efforts to repeal the Hyde Amendment and other pro-life provisions traditionally included in funding legislation, and I remain committed to supporting legislation and efforts to defend vulnerable unborn children and protect the conscience rights of pro-life Americans. Energy & Environment | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Energy & Environment America is a country rich in energy resources and emerging technologies, and I support an all-of-the-above energy strategy that encourages domestic production, reduces our dependency on foreign oil and explores alternative energy solutions. Oil and natural gas production has shaped Oklahoma’s economy since shortly after statehood, and it continues to do so today. While I am supportive of our traditional energy producers and protective of the thousands they employ, I have also supported tax credits that promote renewable energy development—like wind power—and incentivize consumers to use renewable and alternative fuels. Hampering domestic energy production is not the path towards a robust economy and job growth. This administration’s decisions to cancel pipeline production, release millions of barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, and halt federal oil and gas leasing has only caused record-high prices at the pump. I am committed to promoting domestic energy production and keeping America energy independent. I also care deeply for the well-being of our national parks, national forests, wildlife refuges and other public lands. I believe that our natural resources are among our nation's greatest treasures, and Congress should work to ensure that the environment is preserved for future generations. However, I also believe that our country can and should responsibly use these resources to reduce dependence on foreign sources of energy and strengthen self-sufficiency in terms of the minerals that are essential to our economy and security. For Oklahomans, drought and water scarcity is part of our history. Investments in water infrastructure are critical to ensuring the availability and affordability of this critical resource. Doing so will ensure that water resources across the state are managed in a way to meet both our present needs and those of the many generations to come. Economy & Small Business | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Economy & Small Business A healthy economy is the key to a prosperous America. When I travel across the Fourth District of Oklahoma, I am always inspired by the entrepreneurial spirit and can-do attitude of Oklahoma workers and our small businesses, which employ more than half of our state’s workforce. The COVID-19 pandemic and continuing inflation crisis have taken their toll on millions of Americans. Due to inflation, Americans paid $5,200 more in 2022 for the same goods in 2021. Savings are being depleted, and borrowing has reached its highest level since the 2008 Financial Crisis. As your member of Congress, I will support policies that strengthen the American economy and support American businesses, especially our small businesses. It is important to maintain a tax code that supports innovation and entrepreneurship. We must also rein in the Biden Administration’s excessive government spending and misguided policies, which instigated our present inflation crisis and threaten to drive our economy into a painful recession. Additionally, we must address the main drivers of our national debt. If left unchecked, our national debt will threaten America’s economic future with higher interest payments, increased risk of financial crises, higher taxes, and a lower standard of living for future generations. Veterans & Military Retirees | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Veterans & Military Retirees Our veterans served during war and peace and have sacrificed tremendously to protect our freedoms. They are defenders of democracy who served to ensure all Americans can continue to enjoy freedom and peace. I remain committed to holding the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) accountable and ensuring that promises made to our veterans are kept. Our service members must have access to safe housing, good jobs, and the proper healthcare to support their unique needs. I applaud the efforts being made by the Department of Defense (DoD) to enhance our mental health programs and policies, and I stand committed to ensuring that we continue to advance our programs to meet the needs of our people. Too often, our veterans do not receive the care and services they have earned, and the VA system needs to find solutions to fix this. Veterans deserve to receive their benefits promptly and consistently; clearing ongoing backlogs will help us reach this goal. I have supported reforms in Congress to modernize appeals processes, bring accountability to the Department of Veterans Affairs, give student veterans the most significant expansion of GI Bill benefits since the GI Bill was created, and most recently supported the expansion of protections for veterans’ disability and retirement payments. Ongoing proposals to raise TRICARE deductibles, premiums, and co-pays for beneficiaries remain a principal concern for military service members, retirees, and their families. I fully understand that TRICARE is an earned benefit, and I am opposed to a “tiered” enrollment fee structure or “means-testing” for service members, retirees, and their families. I understand that the unique military retirement and healthcare package is a primary incentive for top-quality people to endure the extraordinary demands and sacrifices inherent in a military career spanning 20 or 30 years. I will relentlessly continue to work with my colleagues to preserve and advance pay, benefits, and incentives for the military, retirees, and veterans. Education | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Education As a former educator, I understand how important it is for our children to have access to a quality education, one of the most important building blocks for success. I believe strongly in the authority of parents to direct the education and upbringing of their children. I am committed to ensuring parents and teachers have the tools and resources necessary to provide a world class education to our children, regardless of economic status. During my time on the House Appropriations Committee’s panel for educational funding, I was a strong supporter of Head Start, which provides educational opportunities to low-income children, and GEAR UP and TRIO, which are designed to help disadvantaged students prepare for and succeed in college. Our youth’s future success, and Oklahoma's too, requires access to affordable and quality higher education. With a better-educated workforce, Oklahoma can attract, retain, and expand high-paying jobs. I believe federal financial assistance for students should be available to students regardless of whether they are seeking a degree at a four-year institution or pursuing career and technical education (CTE). CTE is a vital component of our secondary and postsecondary educational system. Healthcare | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Healthcare More than half of Americans obtain their health insurance through private health insurers. I strongly support a role for private enterprise in American healthcare and believe the answers to our nation’s health care problems entail market-based solutions, not in granting the federal government sole control over the nation’s health care industry. Americans deserve access to health care options that fit the needs of their families. Congress must expand access to health care savings accounts (HSAs), which enable individuals to set aside pre-tax dollars for their health care costs, and the services and products an HSA can cover. Congress should also make permanent current – and temporary – expansions in telehealth services, which have broadened health care access for millions of families. Congress must also address continued market consolidation in the health care industry, which reduces patient choice and needlessly drives up the cost of health care. As a former member of the House Appropriations Committee’s panel for health care spending, I have been a strong supporter of increasing resources for the National Institutes of Health and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Federal support for medical research at our nation’s universities and laboratories – including those in Oklahoma – quickens the pace of research, offers the chance to bring to market new and innovative therapies, and supports local economies where such research is conducted. Additionally, the COVID-19 pandemic taught us that public health security is national security. It is important we maintain a well-resourced public health infrastructure, both federally and at the state-level and ensure public health officials make transparent, fact-based decisions in the public interest. Agriculture | Representative Tom Cole Skip to main content Agriculture Production agriculture is the heart of America. In fact, the Fourth District of Oklahoma is the proud home to more than 13,000 farms and ranches. We cannot take for granted the hard work and innovation of the agriculture sector or the value they add to the economy. Sadly, production agriculture has become an afterthought in a country whose citizens spend a smaller percentage of their income on food than anywhere else in the world. While our population continues to shift to urban centers, many Americans are unaware of the hard work and innovation our farmers and ranchers bring to production agriculture. There are no better stewards of the land than those whose livelihood depends on that land. I will continue to work with my colleagues to roll back burdensome rules and regulations that have often posed needlessly high compliance costs for farmers and ranchers, which is crippling for agriculture production in rural America. I work closely with Congressman Frank Lucas (OK-03), a former Chairman of the House Committee on Agriculture, and other members in the Oklahoma delegation to ensure that our farmers and ranchers are not left behind and that safety nets, such as crop insurance, remain in place to protect against the volatile effects of drought, floods, tornadoes and other disasters.
